005/**
006 * <p>
007 * Main application class and execution entry point for DayPlanner.
008 * </p>
009 * <p>
010 * Loads the configured activity files, runs the interactive menu, and saves
011 * changes when the user quits.
012 * </p>
013 */
014public class DayPlanner {
015    /**
016     * Input instance used for reading console user input.
017     */
018    private static final Input KEYBOARD = new Input();
019
020    /**
021     * Directory path where data files are stored.
022     */
023    private static final String DATA_DIRECTORY = "dat";
024
025    /**
026     * File name of the RAS data file loaded and persisted.
027     */
028    private static String dataFileName;
029
030    /**
031     * The master list of activities currently loaded into the planner.
032     */
033    private static ActivityList activities;
034
035
036    /**
037     * Main entry point for the DayPlanner application.
038     * 
039     * @param args Command-line arguments; expects exactly one argument specifying the data file name.
040     */
041    public static void main(String[] args) {
042        // Get the data file name from args
043        if (args.length != 1) {
044            StringBuilder error = new StringBuilder();
045            error.append("The program has halted because you did not specify a data file name.");
046            error.append("\nA sample file named 'sampleData.ras' is included. Specify it as the first execution argument:");
047            error.append("\n\tjava -jar bin/DayPlanner.jar sampleData.ras");
048
049            System.out.println("\n"+error.toString()+"\n");
050            return;
051        }
052        dataFileName = args[0];
053
054        // Initialize activitylist
055        try {
056            activities = new ActivityList(DATA_DIRECTORY, dataFileName);
057        } catch (Exception e) {
058            System.out.println("\nError initializing activitylist from this data file ("+dataFileName+").\n");
059            return;
060        }
061
062        // Now the the ActivityList is initialized we can Show the GUI
063        System.out.println("Showing GUI. Ctrl+C on this terminal window to quit immediately without saving.");
064        new GUIDayPlanner(activities);
065
066        /*
067        // This is Legacy Code that executes the old, terminal-based command loop.
068        // Perform the command loop until the user quits
069        boolean doLoop = true;
070        while (doLoop)
071            doLoop = commandLoop();
072
073        // The above loop only finishes when the user wants to quit
074        quit(true);
075        */
076    }
077
078
079    /**
080     * Saves the list and exits the program.
081     * 
082     * @param print Whether to print output.
083     * @return True if there was a RAS save failure, false otherwise.
084     */
085    public static boolean quit(boolean print) {
086        // Attempt to save the list in RAS format
087        boolean errors = saveToRAS();
088
089        if (print) {
090            if (errors)    System.out.println("\nError saving the list.");
091            else           System.out.println("\nThe list was saved successfully.");
092            System.out.println("\nNow quitting DayPlanner. Goodbye!");
093        }
094
095        return errors;
096    }
097
098
099
100    /**
101     * Get a large greeting message.
102     * 
103     * @return Greeting message.
104     */
105    public static String getGreetingMessage() {
106        StringBuilder msg = new StringBuilder();
107        msg.append("\n\n\t\t===-=-==-=====-==-=-===\n\n");
108        msg.append("\t『 DAY PLANNER 』  Main Menu\n");
109        msg.append(DayPlannerUtils.getGreeting(activities.size()));
110        msg.append("\nPlease enter a command:");
111        msg.append("\t1. add    - Insert a new activity");
112        msg.append("\t2. search - Search for an activity");
113        msg.append("\t3. quit   - Exit DayPlanner\n");
114        return msg.toString();
115    }
116
117
118
119    /**
120     * Displays the main menu and processes a single user command.
121     * 
122     * @return {@code true} to show the menu again, or {@code false} after
123     *         processing quit.
124     */
125    public static boolean commandLoop() {
126        // Print a big greeting message
127        System.out.println(getGreetingMessage());
128
129        String cmd;
130        MenuOption option;
131        while (true) {
132            cmd = KEYBOARD.readCommand();
133            try {
134                option = MenuOption.parse(cmd);
135                if (option == null)
136                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid command: \"" + cmd + "\".");
137                break;
138            } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
139                System.out.println(e.getMessage());
140                System.out.println("Please enter 'add' (or 'a'), 'search' (or 's'), or 'quit' (or 'q'):");
141            }
142        }
143
144        switch (option) {
145            case ADD    -> addActivity();
146            case SEARCH -> searchForActivity();
147            case QUIT   -> { return false; }
148        }
149
150        return true;
151    }
152

155    /**
156     * Saves the activity list to its RAS file.
157     * 
158     * @return {@code true} if the list could not be saved; {@code false}
159     *         if the list was written successfully.
160     */
161    public static boolean saveToRAS() {
162        return !activities.saveToRAS(DATA_DIRECTORY, dataFileName);
163    }

167    /**
168     * Prompts the user for details and adds a new activity to the appropriate list.
169     */
170    public static void addActivity() {
171        System.out.println("Let's add a new activity to the DayPlanner.");
172
173        // 1. Activity type
174        ActivityType type;
175
176        while (true) {
177            System.out.println("Enter the type of this activity.");
178            System.out.println("For Home, type 'home' or 1. For School, type 'school' or 2. For Other, type 'other' or 3:");
179            try {
180                type = ActivityType.parse(KEYBOARD.readString());
181                if (type == null)
182                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid activity type.");
183                break;
184            } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
185                System.out.println(e.getMessage() + " Try again:");
186            }
187        }
188
189        // 2. Title
190        String title;
191        while (true) {
192            System.out.println("Enter a title.");
193            try {
194                title = KEYBOARD.readString();
195                if (title == null || title.isBlank())
196                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Title cannot be empty.");
197                break;
198            } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
199                System.out.println(e.getMessage() + " Try again:");
200            }
201        }
202
203        // 3. Start time
204        System.out.println("Enter a starting time.");
205        Time startTime = KEYBOARD.readTime();
206
207        // 4. End time
208        Time endTime;
209        while (true) {
210            System.out.println("Enter an ending time.");
211            try {
212                endTime = KEYBOARD.readTime();
213                if (startTime.compareTo(endTime) >= 0)
214                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Ending time has to be after the starting time (" + startTime + ").");
215                break;
216            } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
217                System.out.println(e.getMessage() + " Try again:");
218            }
219        }
220
221        // 5. Optional comment
222        System.out.println("Would you like to enter a comment?");
223        String comment = null;
224        if (KEYBOARD.readBool()) {
225            System.out.println("Enter a comment.");
226            comment = KEYBOARD.readString();
227            if (comment != null && comment.isEmpty())
228                comment = null;
229        }
230
231        // 6. Location (Other activities only)
232        String location = null;
233        if (type == ActivityType.OTHER) {
234            while (true) {
235                System.out.println("Enter a location.");
236                try {
237                    location = KEYBOARD.readString();
238                    if (location == null || location.isBlank())
239                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Location cannot be empty for Other activities.");
240                    break;
241                } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
242                    System.out.println(e.getMessage() + " Try again:");
243                }
244            }
245        }
246
247        // 7. Instantiate and insert activity
248        try {
249            Activity act = switch (type) {
250                case HOME   -> new HomeActivity(title, startTime, endTime, comment);
251                case SCHOOL -> new SchoolActivity(title, startTime, endTime, comment);
252                case OTHER  -> new OtherActivity(title, startTime, endTime, comment, location);
253            };
254
255            if (act != null) {
256                activities.add(act);
257                System.out.println("Successfully created the new activity:\n\t" + act.toString());
258            }
259        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
260            System.out.println("Error creating activity: " + e.getMessage());
261        }
262    }

266    /**
267     * Asks which activities to look for, then displays every activity that
268     * matches the filters.
269     */
270    public static void searchForActivity() {
271        System.out.println("Let's search for activities in the DayPlanner.");
272
273        // an empty type means the search should include every activity
274        ActivityType type = null;
275        while (true) {
276            System.out.println("Enter activity type ('home', 'school', 'other'), or press Enter to search all types:");
277            String input = KEYBOARD.readString();
278            if (input == null || input.isEmpty())
279                break;
280
281            try {
282                type = ActivityType.parse(input);
283                if (type == null)
284                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid activity type: \"" + input + "\".");
285                break;
286            } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
287                System.out.println(e.getMessage() + " Please enter 'home', 'school', 'other', or press Enter to skip:");
288            }
289        }
290
291        // FILTER BY KEYWORD
292        // if input is blank, do not restrict titles
293        // otherwise, treat each word as its own filter
294        System.out.println("Enter title keywords (separated by spaces), or press Enter to match any title:");
295        String keywordInput = KEYBOARD.readString();
296        String[] keywords = keywordInput.isEmpty()
297            ? null
298            : keywordInput.trim().split("\\s+");
299
300        // FILTER BY TIME
301        // null = unbound
302        Time[] period = DayPlannerUtils.readTimePeriod(KEYBOARD);
303        Time searchStart = period[0];
304        Time searchEnd = period[1];
305
306        int totalMatches = 0;
307        System.out.println("\nSearch results:");
308
309        for (int position : activities.findTitleMatches(keywords)) {
310            Activity activity = activities.get(position);
311            if (DayPlannerUtils.matchesCriteria(activity, type, searchStart, searchEnd)) {
312                totalMatches++;
313                System.out.println(String.format(
314                    "\t%d. %s",
315                    totalMatches,
316                    activity.toString()
317                ));
318            }
319        }
320
321        // how many activities matched?
322        if (totalMatches == 0)
323            System.out.println("\tNo activities matched your search request.");
324        else
325            System.out.println("\nTotal matched activities: " + totalMatches);
326
327        // press enter to continue
328        KEYBOARD.pressEnterToContinue();
329    }
